description: Build the coordinator Judges management section: list UI in CoordinatorJudgesSection.tsx plus AddJudge/RemoveJudge modals, scoped to the single pageantId prop (no org_owner-style fan-out across multiple pageants, no multi-pageant select, no stats cards, no search/filter bar — much simpler than the org_owner reference). Independent of FEAT-001/002/004; shares only the assign/revoke copy pattern with FEAT-004 (Tabulators), not any code.
steps: Read app/(org_owner)/org_owner/teams/judges/page.tsx in full for the addSchema shape, the Add modal form layout (2-col firstName/lastName + full-width email + gold-tinted info callout box), and the Remove ConfirmModal copy — but ignore entirely the JudgeFetcher fan-out component, the multi-pageant <select>, the StatCard stats row, and the search/filter bar; none of that applies here since this section is already scoped to one pageantId. Also re-read src/features/coordinator/components/modals/AddCandidates.tsx/DeactivateCandidate.tsx for this codebase's own modal-file conventions (exports, Field component, handleClose guard shape). Read src/features/coordinator/hooks/useStaff.ts to confirm useJudges(pageantId), useAssignJudge(pageantId) takes AssignPageantStaffRequest, useRevokeJudge(pageantId) takes userId string. Read src/types/org-owner.ts for PageantStaffResponse (userId, email, firstName, lastName, role, isActive) and AssignPageantStaffRequest (email, firstName?, lastName?) shapes. Do not modify useStaff.ts or org-owner.ts.

Create src/features/coordinator/components/modals/AddJudge.tsx: "use client", assignJudgeSchema = z.object({firstName: z.string().min(1, "First name is required").max(100), lastName: z.string().min(1, "Last name is required").max(100), email: z.string().min(1, "Email is required").email("Enter a valid email")}), export schema/AssignJudgeFormValues/Field/fieldInput tokens (this codebase's own dark-navy Field/fieldInput, matching AddCandidates.tsx's tokens, not org_owner's locally-duplicated copy, so later Add/RemoveJudge files have one place to import from). Props {pageantId, open, onClose}, useAssignJudge(pageantId), form: 2-col firstName/lastName grid, full-width email field, the gold/white-tinted info callout ("If a new account is created, a temporary password will be generated and emailed...") copied from org_owner's pattern since it is accurate here too. handleClose guards `if (assignJudge.isPending) return;`. Modal size="md" (3 simple fields, matches org_owner's default-md Modal usage). Toast success `${firstName} ${lastName} assigned as judge.` / error via ApiError, exactly like AddCandidates.tsx's error handling style.

Create src/features/coordinator/components/modals/RemoveJudge.tsx mirroring DeactivateCandidate.tsx's structure (thin ConfirmModal wrapper) but using useRevokeJudge(pageantId) (mutateAsync(judge.userId)), props {pageantId, judge: PageantStaffResponse | null, onClose}, title "Remove Judge", confirmLabel "Remove", destructive, description `Remove ${judge.firstName} ${judge.lastName} from this pageant? They will no longer be able to submit scores.` (dropped the multi-pageant "from {pageantName}" clause since scope is already single-pageant), toast.success(`${judge.firstName} ${judge.lastName} removed.`) on success, ApiError-based error toast.

Rebuild src/features/coordinator/components/management/CoordinatorJudgesSection.tsx replacing the stub: "use client", props {pageantId}, useJudges(pageantId) for data, local state isAddModalOpen/removeTarget. Follow CoordinatorCandidatesSection.tsx's structure: loading skeleton, isError block, header (title "Judges", subtitle, "+ Add Judge" gold button), count line, empty state ("No judges yet" / "Add your first judge"), bordered list with desktop grid columns (Judge name+email combined cell like candidates' name+subtext pattern, Status(isActive), Actions) and the md:hidden mobile card block — note there is NO Edit action, only Remove, since staff assignment has no update endpoint (matches org_owner judges page which also has no edit). Status badge reuses the CandidateStatus-shaped active/inactive pairing. Wire AddJudge/RemoveJudge modals at the bottom of the returned JSX.
acceptance_criteria: AddJudge.tsx and RemoveJudge.tsx exist under src/features/coordinator/components/modals/ and CoordinatorJudgesSection.tsx no longer renders the stub text
The judges list has only Remove as a row action (no Edit button), reflecting that useStaff.ts exposes no update endpoint for staff
RemoveJudge.tsx uses 'Remove' wording (not 'Deactivate' or 'Delete'), matching the revoke semantics of useRevokeJudge
The section does not contain any multi-pageant fan-out, pageant <select>, stats cards, or search/filter bar — it is scoped purely to the pageantId prop
`npx tsc --noEmit` run from frontend/ exits 0 with no type errors introduced by these 3 files
verification: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit — confirm exit code 0
cd frontend && npm run build — confirm the build completes without errors

Manually re-read all 3 touched/created files end-to-end confirming: Modal size="md", handleClose pending-guard present, toast wiring present, 'Remove' wording, and no leftover org_owner fan-out/multi-pageant code was copied in
findings: Created AddJudge.tsx (assignJudgeSchema, AssignJudgeFormValues, Field/fieldInput/fieldLabel/fieldError tokens, 2-col firstName/lastName grid + full-width email + gold-tinted info callout, Modal size="md", handleClose guards on assignJudge.isPending only since no image upload) and RemoveJudge.tsx (thin ConfirmModal wrapper using useRevokeJudge(pageantId).mutateAsync(judge.userId), title 'Remove Judge', confirmLabel 'Remove', destructive, single-pageant-scoped description with no pageantName clause). Rebuilt CoordinatorJudgesSection.tsx replacing the stub: useJudges(pageantId) for data, loading skeleton, isError block, header with gold '+ Add Judge' button, count line, empty state, bordered list with desktop grid (Judge name+email, Status, Actions) and md:hidden mobile card block, Remove-only row actions (no Edit, matching useStaff.ts having no update endpoint for staff). No multi-pageant fan-out, pageant <select>, stats cards, or search/filter bar were introduced. npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 and npm run build completes successfully with no errors introduced.
